caseName: Murphy v. Waterfront Comm'n of NY Harbor
caseNameFull: MURPHY Et Al. v. WATERFRONT COMMISSION OF NEW YORK HARBOR
attorneys: Harold Krieger for appellants., William P. Sirignano and Irving Malchman for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
